current_bottleneck: Broader observable state adds some incremental linear signal for per-cell future levels, but all audited failure proxies still have negative holdout R2. There is not enough evidence for a quick exogenous-state conditioning repair.
last_result_summary: 516a implemented and ran an observable-state predictability audit on pre-validation windows. IV-only vs IV+ret/price/slopes/skews/levels ridge predictors were compared for future level, vol-of-vol, and jump targets. IV+state improved per-cell future mean level R2 from -0.735 to -0.317 and h30 level R2 from -0.903 to -0.504, but every target remained negative-R2 on holdout. Future max jump and q90 jump scale did not improve.
next_step_recommendation: Do not add an exogenous-state branch as a quick local experiment. The next HEAD step should be a paradigm decision: either define a separately reported policy calibration layer for deployable risk use, or stop local IV-only learned-law research at the 8/11 frontier and plan a larger new-core/data program.
current_best_note: Both score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 510a improves coverage geometry and path KS but keeps level KS 10/25 and regime layer2 0/8 while thinning conditionality/cointegration margins.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
